findings.title: Missing automated coverage for `context_build` D9 error result
findings.description: Description: The slice design's Functional Requirements say a guide without the profile or prompt must make `cf build` exit non-zero with the `AdoptionError` message and make `context_build` return it as an error, with no concept prompt. Tasks 9/9T cover the resolver D9 checks, Task 10/10T cover rethrow, Task 12 fixture 12 covers rejection through the pipeline, and Task 15 step 4 manually covers `cfl build` non-zero. But no task asserts the MCP `context_build` error result for a missing profile or prompt; Task 13 and Task 15 step 5 cover only successful parity. Add an MCP-level assertion that `isError` is true, the text contains the D9 `AdoptionError` message, and no concept prompt was produced.

findings.title: Renderer tests do not cover every outcome
findings.description: Description: Technical Requirements require `renderAdoptionFacts` tests for "every outcome", and the design defines `AdoptionOutcome` as a discriminated union with `adoption-in-progress`, `adoption-closed`, `already-planned`, `brownfield`, and `greenfield`. Task 8T tests brownfield, adoption-in-progress, `NOT_EVALUATED`, state notice, "none found", history unknown, and the squadron bullet, but omits `adoption-closed`, `already-planned`, and `greenfield`. Task 8's exhaustive switch helps compile-time safety but does not satisfy the explicit test requirement. Add those outcome cases or narrow the design requirement.

findings.title: D9 write-failure test omits the state-unchanged assertion
findings.description: Description: Technical Requirements explicitly call for D9's write failure to assert `AdoptionError` and "state unchanged", plus guide-check-before-write ordering. Task 9T's guide-without-profile case asserts state remains `''` before the write, satisfying ordering, but the write-failure case only requires the error to name `.context-forge.toml` and `--it brownfield-adoption`. Add a read-back assertion that `adoption.state` remains unset after the write failure.

findings.title: Guide fixture instructions are not clear enough for the D9 parser
findings.description: Description: Task 9T says to create the brownfield guide fixture as a copy of `packages/core/tests/fixtures/test-project/project-documents/ai-project-guide/project-guides/prompt.ai-project.system.md` with a `brownfield-adoption: [...]` profile line and a `##### Brownfield Adoption` prompt section. That existing fixture has no `context_profiles` block, while `ContextProfileParser.parseProfiles` requires a fenced `context_profiles:` YAML block. A junior AI could add the profile line outside the block and get `{}` from `parseProfiles`, leaving D9 profile checks and all Task 12 integration fixtures using the brownfield guide fixture unreliable. Specify adding the production-shaped fenced `context_profiles:` block with the profile line, and keep the separate "profile but no prompt" fixture explicit.

findings.title: Caller/pipeline changes do not have an immediate successor test task
findings.description: Description: The test-with rule requires implementation groups to be immediately followed by test tasks. Tasks 1-10 are paired as `Task N` / `Task NT`, and integration/parity tests follow later, but Task 11 changes `createContextPipeline`, `build.ts`, `contextTools.ts`, updates every test caller, and adds `contextTools.test.ts` assertions inside the implementation task itself before Task 11C. Split the caller/test updates into a `Task 11T` immediately after the implementation steps, or explicitly restructure this group so the test task is the immediate successor.
